rule: D&H keys a row by (dh_id, sub_period). Every female dh_id that occurs under more than one sub_period is classified here as one woman (a cross-reference stub and her full Brief Life) or as different women; pipeline.authority.royal_women refuses any repeated female dh_id not listed. Each basis cites the rows' own fields (reconciled.jsonl) or this directory's README.
